# Minimal Knowledge Ledger

Log only the facts that are both non-obvious and essential for future tasks in this repository.

## Preserve

- Exact commands and parameters that produced verified results here.
- Boundaries discovered through failure that future work must respect.
- Unexpected tool behaviors that changed outcomes (sequencing, quoting, host targeting).

## Purge

- Generic how-to content unrelated to this specific project.
- Duplicate signals already surfaced by version control or inline documentation.
- Wordy passages that restate the task without contributing new constraints.

## Update Discipline

When new findings contradict an existing entry, that entry is rewritten. Contradictory guidance is never stacked — only the current truth is kept.

## Operating Norm

Confirm outcomes with the project's own validation tooling. Every edit should be the smallest change that satisfies the requirement.
